pins.title: Easy Vacation House Dinners: Low Boil, Burgers, Caprese
pins.description: The meals worth cooking at a waterfront rental: a country low boil in one pot, bacon burgers, caprese on the porch, and whatever the crab pot gives you at dawn.
pins.altText: The green-cabineted kitchen at Captain's Cottage, window over the sink facing the water.

pins.title: What to Cook at a Waterfront Rental
pins.description: Order groceries before you leave home, then cook simply. Shrimp tacos, oysters roasted in a hot pan, pasta with whatever seafood you picked up on the Northern Neck.
pins.altText: A screened dining porch set for dinner above a Chesapeake creek.

pins.title: Country Low Boil: The One-Pot Vacation Dinner
pins.description: Shrimp, corn, smoked sausage and potatoes in one pot, forty minutes start to table, poured out in the middle of the table. The vacation dinner nobody has to hover over.
pins.altText: A waterfront kitchen with open shelving and a view of the creek beyond.
